name: Little Haven
subtitle: A town dream and a roadside motel

apps.name: Little Haven
apps.subtitle: Walk, work and build your motel.
apps.localizedDescription: Wake up and walk freely around a roadside motel, its office, pool, parking and guest rooms. Meet arriving clients, assign rooms and collect their payments. Pick up tools at the office, then make beds, collect trash and mop spills inside each vacated room. Interact with paint cabinets, beds, the front desk and construction plots to customize and expand your property. Guests walk to their rooms and depart along the grounds. Sneak into occupied rooms, take belongings and escape before being caught. Save at the office or sleep to create checkpoints. Original cut-paper cartoon characters and smooth eight-direction movement.

versions.localizedDescription: The walkable motel: explore the grounds and interiors with a movement stick, meet clients and collect payments in person, carry cleaning tools, make beds, collect trash, mop spills, customize physical rooms and expand the property. Existing motel saves are supported.

The motel chapter: wake up after the town prologue, manage three rooms, welcome guests, customize rooms and office, expand to nine rooms, and risk sneaking into occupied rooms. Getting caught restores your last checkpoint.
New cut-paper cartoon characters and matching portraits. Hold an arrow to walk smoothly; release to stop.
